subjectOf.text: Because CIAs have so far been used predominantly in the health care industry, and because that industry has a public or quasi-public good character, the application of CIAs outside health care could be limited, and without broader application their impact on corporate law may be limited as well.

subjectOf.text: Kaal limits the reach of his own proposal: donors motivated by personal or local causes may have no interest in scaling impact at all, so the paper's target audience is only the subgroup of high dollar donors who want technology based improvements in philanthropy.
subjectOf.abstract: In short, donors who are motivated by their personal or local interests may not be motivated by scaling impact overall.
